unsupported: This version of the app cannot reach a DX cluster
noCall: No operator call to log in to the cluster with
connectFailed: Could not reach the cluster node
needsPassword: The cluster node asks for a password — set it in Settings › DX Cluster
loginFailed: The cluster node refused the login
timeout: The cluster node did not answer
tooSoon: Another spot went out a moment ago — try again in a few seconds
invalidCall: The cluster cannot take that call
